newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch cheese production up 1.5 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dutch cheese production up 1.5 percent in 1996.

text.p: Cheese production in the Netherlands rose to 690,000 tonnes in 1996, up 10,000 tonnes from 1995, the Dutch dairy association said on Monday.
Figures showed that 55 percent of milk produced in the country went to making cheese, up from 40 percent 10 years ago.
This year, cheese production is expected to top 700,000 tonnes, worth an estimated 4.5 billion guilders.
The association added that annual cheese consumption now stood at 14.7 kilos per head of the population.
